{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
valid_converted_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print required numbers
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted_df)}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
